text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
"And now for a special feature! It's time
for
today's Twinkle Legends segment!"

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
"Allow us to introduce you to the Triple
Crown
Champions, as well as the
Umamusume who have
shone brightly in
the Triple Tiara!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, figures. There's no special feature
for
Umamusume who threw away glory to
switch
tours.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Is there anyone who's ever gone from
the Oka
Sho to the Derby and won?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So it's never been done before... Oh,
man. This is
gettin' my blood pumpin'!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
But that must mean it's super difficult,
right?
Changin' tours will give me
completely different
opponents, too.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The racers who went to the Satsuki Sho
already
know who they're up against, so
racing 'em for the
first time at the Derby
itself is nuts.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I don't regret runnin' in the Oka Sho...
but that
detour sure came at a price.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The other racers picked their tracks with
a goal in
mind. I doubt either side will
take kindly to
Vodka switching from the
Tiara to the Crown.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I can't see a way out... I've got no clue
what to do.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
How do I even start thinkin' about this,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... Like ones that've run in the
Derby before?
choice_data_list: All I can think of is... maybe asking an upperclassman?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Okay. I know exactly who to talk to!
Someone
who's an even bigger renegade
than me...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You wanna go from the Oka Sho to the
Japanese
Derby?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And I want your opinion, seeing as
you've
had so many famous exploits
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: You're really planning on going for it?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: That's why I'm here.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Please... Give me some advice.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I've got nothing to say.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: What?! C'mon, please!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Stop asking me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Just tell me about the Derby, then! It's
my dream
race, so at least tell me what
it's like to run there!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I have to hear it from you, Brian! I have to know how it looked from your perspective.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmph...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...The Japanese Derby is a special place.
It's not
for people who're just following
in their role
model's footsteps.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It's for the people ready to tear their
own
inspiration down from the throne.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: To tear... their own inspiration down?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
If your soul is burning for the Derby, you
go. If
not, don't bother. There's no
choice to make.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I think you might be like me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Really? How so?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You don't see a point in trying to map
out the
future. Riding some preset
logic-based rail isn't
gonna give you the
satisfaction you want.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You're starved for something bigger than
winning
or losing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
So go where your gut takes you. You've
come too
far to turn tail trying to act
normal now.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
That's why I don't have any advice for
you. We're
done here.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Brian...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That night, Vodka tells me about her

conversation with Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: In the end, it's my decision. Our decision.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So what do ya think? If it were you, how
would
you look at it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The first thing Vodka needs to consider
is...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Cool is what I've been after this whole
time...
choice_data_list: I wonder what being cool really means.
I wonder what being cool really means, huh.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
No wavering, no giving in, and no
looking back...
That's my definition of
cool.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: The cool thing to do...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's right... I should do whatever
I think is
coolest...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vodka thinks for a long time. She looks
like she's
scowling at herself.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I think the cool thing to do is...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Tackling the thing I've been dreaming of
ever
since I was a kid.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Even if it goes against the norm, and
even if
everyone else thinks it's
reckless...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's not about who my opponents are or
what they
think. It's about me, and
myself.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta live by my own guidelines, no
matter
what anyone else thinks of me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Inspirations aren't people to
chase—they're
people to overcome.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That's what being cool means to me.
Which
means...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The long night is finally over.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, will ya stick with me through
this?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Everyone might laugh at us. We might
get
crushed. But even so...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna be true to myself and be cool!
So...
we're goin' to the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeah! That's right! This is my path!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna do exactly what I want! I'm
goin' from
the Oka Sho to the Japanese
Derby!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: It doesn't matter what anyone else says! I'm doin' my career my style!
